title: Building Blocks Concept Map
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Explore how the 21 Chapter 1 concepts depend on one another, then select the direct prerequisites of six concepts on the map.

learningObjectives: The learner will explain which earlier concepts each Chapter 1 concept depends on by identifying its direct prerequisites in the chapter's concept map, correctly answering at least five of six prerequisite questions.
prerequisites: All 21 concepts in Chapter 1, and the meaning of a dependency arrow from the section "Putting the Building Blocks Together."

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read a dependency map and select answers on the map itself
keyQuestions: Which concepts do the arrows leaving this concept point to?
commonMisconceptions: The concepts are independent vocabulary words
Advanced-sounding concepts such as Higher-Order Thinking must have many prerequisites
Arrows point from a prerequisite to what it enables
assessmentOpportunities: What are the direct prerequisites of Direct Instruction?
How many direct prerequisites does Higher-Order Thinking have?

controls.name: Concept nodes
controls.description: In explore mode, click to read a definition. In the quiz, click to select or unselect.

controls.name: Clear selection
controls.description: Unselects every concept for the current question.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the selected concepts against the direct prerequisites.

controls.name: Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset
controls.description: Change the view of the map. The mouse wheel does not zoom.
